description: This header file defines thread synchronization primitives such as mutexes, condition variables, and shared variables within the ocudulog::detail namespace, providing abstractions over pthreads for thread safety and concurrency control.

classes.name: mutex
classes.description: Abstraction of a pthread mutex with automatic initialization and destruction.

classes.name: scoped_lock
classes.description: RAII object for automatically locking and unlocking a mutex.

classes.name: shared_variable
classes.description: Template class for thread-safe access and modification of a variable.

classes.name: condition_variable
classes.description: Abstraction of a pthread condition variable with wait, signal, and broadcast capabilities.

classes.name: cond_var_scoped_lock
classes.description: RAII object for automatically locking and unlocking a condition variable.

methods.name: build_timeout
methods.description: Creates a timespec structure representing an absolute timeout based on milliseconds.
